Diwali Special: 4 Traditional Indian Snacks!
Make your Diwali celebrations even more delicious with four crispy, flavourful and traditional snacks from different parts of India! Perfect for festive gatherings, sharing with family and friends, or enjoying with a hot cup of chai.
Here's what we're making:
Om‌apodi – Thin, crispy South Indian sev made with gram flour and rice flour, seasoned with spices and crunchy fried curry leaves.
Bhajanee Chakli – A classic festive snack with a beautiful spiral shape, a crispy texture and the delicious flavour of sesame seeds.
